versions.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-persistent-memory skill, providing persistent memory with automatic context capture and semantic search.
- Features include auto-capture and auto-recall of information, powered by SQLite + FTS5 for full-text search.
- Provides tools for searching, storing, retrieving, and deleting memories.
- Includes detailed setup instructions for integration with OpenClaw.
- REST API endpoints for memory management and health checks.
